concerns.text: Task T004 (cleaning & merge) consumes ecological covariates (migration_status, breeding_latitude, body_mass_g) but no preceding task produces or fetches these covariates. This violates the non‑negotiable Constitution Principle VI (Ecological Data Integration) which requires a provenance field for each covariate and a producer step. Add a task (e.g., T004a) that downloads the AnAge/BirdLife covariate files and records provenance before T004, and place it before T004 in the ordering.
